## Problem

Describe the concrete editorial, locale, semantic, or provenance problem.

## Change

Explain the smallest change that addresses the problem.

## Evidence

List project terminology, official regional usage, source behavior, or other evidence.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/validate_repo.py`.
- [ ] I added or updated forward cases for behavior changes.
- [ ] I checked facts, numbers, versions, conditions, negation, attribution, and order.
- [ ] I preserved commands, links, identifiers, placeholders, quotations, and markup.
- [ ] I identified any native or domain review that is still needed.
- [ ] I have the right to redistribute any example or third-party material in this PR.

## Limitations

List unresolved variants, known false positives, and work deliberately left out of scope.
